# Nested Lists

## Bullet lists — 3 levels

- Level 1 item A
  - Level 2 item A1
    - Level 3 item A1a
    - Level 3 item A1b
  - Level 2 item A2
- Level 1 item B
  - Level 2 item B1
    - Level 3 item B1a
      - Level 4 item B1a-i
        - Level 5 item B1a-i-alpha

## Ordered lists — nested

1. First
   1. First-child
      1. First-grandchild
         1. First-great-grandchild
   2. Second-child
2. Second
   1. Only-child
3. Third

## Ordered list starting from a number other than 1

7. Item seven
8. Item eight
9. Item nine

## Mixed bullet and ordered

1. Prepare ingredients
   - Flour
   - Eggs
   - Sugar
2. Mix everything
   - Use a whisk
     1. Start slow
     2. Increase speed
   - Scrape the sides
3. Bake at 180°C
